contexts.text: The earth = all the lower things... as the lower rational and natural things... such as are those things which are in the lower Heavens...
Knowledges from scientifics; thus lower truths. Signified. AC 2576:10.
For what is lower in man is perceived from what is higher. Reference.
Lower things are compounds of higher ones. (See Degree.) AC 5114:3.
That (the Lord betook Himself) to lower rational things; or from interior appearances to exterior ones. Signified, Explained.
A valleyslower things; or, what is the same, exterior ones.
To lower things still. Signified, Explained.
That he taught those things of the Church which are lower. Signified, Explained.

For the lower things of the Church are said to be from the Divine Natural and Sensuous of the Lord; not that these things are lower in the Lord; for in the Lord... everything is infinite... but because it is so with man. Explained.
If the lower things were to receive good from the Lord immediately, they would either obscure or pervert it; for they are relatively more imperfect.
The things which are lower ought to serve interior things. Lower things are the truths of the Church in the Natural, which are represented by the sons of Jacob...
The truths which are from (the Celestial Kingdom) in lower things. Signified, Explained.
The feet = natural things; thus lower things; for natural things are below.
As to his lower things in which are interior ones. Signified, Explained.
They stood in the lower parts of the mountain () = far from the good of celestial love. Explained.
Lower () = the lowest part of Heaven.
A closer and stronger influx into the lower parts. Signified, Explained. AR 346.
The Lord's operation into the lower parts... Signified, Explained.
The human mind... may be let down to a degree lower and lower...
In the World of lower Spirits...
By lower things are meant exterior things. AE 595, Explained.
External things are signified by the lower parts of the earth ().
Progression towards the lower parts. Signified, Explained.
In proportion as lower things (in the Spiritual World) are in order, higher things are so. Explained.
That then in the lower parts, where the evil are, there were conflicts and tumults of thoughts, and ratiocinations... Signified, Explained.
3. For to operate into lower things is according to order; for this is to operate into the things which are derived...
